title: WorkflowScheduledEventV1Data
description: Kernel-internal schedule-plane tick: a definition's `on.schedule` occurrence came due and the sweeper fired it. One event per (definition version, occurrence) - the envelope id is UUIDv5 over the schedule namespace, so the trigger-row convergence law makes the delivery exactly-once without a claim row. Carried as a trigger envelope copy like every wire event; consumed only by the workflow sink.
